clue.text: Dogged Army volunteers I commanded

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
to command troops is to lead them, so commanded gives led

explanation.surface: A soldier recalls leading a squad of reservists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dogged' looks like an adjective meaning stubborn, but here it is the verb: followed closely.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to follow them closely, exactly the sense of shadowing or trailing.

clue.text: Rodents found under a priestly mantle

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece found under another is written after it in the grid

parts.note: mice are small rodents

explanation.surface: Vermin are discovered hiding beneath a cleric's vestment.
explanation.definitionFit: An amice is a white linen vestment worn round the neck and shoulders by a priest at Mass.

clue.text: Scolded after fine material was torn

indicators.note: after places the scolding word behind the material in the answer

parts.note: lace is a delicate openwork fabric
to rate someone is an old word for berating them

explanation.surface: Someone got told off when their delicate fabric was ripped.
explanation.definitionFit: A lacerated thing has been ripped or gashed, the sense of being rent.

clue.text: Several people taking the plunge

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned word meaning various or sundry

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an archaic adjective for sundry or various and the plural noun for swimmers who plunge headfirst.

clue.text: Child consumes everything but vegetable

indicators.note: consumes says the child word swallows the other piece, holding it inside

parts.note: a scion is a descendant or child of a family
all means everything

explanation.surface: A fussy youngster eats all the food on the plate except the greens.
explanation.definitionFit: A scallion is a spring onion, a green vegetable of the onion family.

clue.text: Use the little remaining to clean one's gun?

definitions.meaning: to make do with whatever scraps are left when resources run low
a literal reading: scouring out the barrel of a firearm

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom comes from scooping the last dregs from a barrel; read literally it describes scouring a firearm's bore.

clue.text: Took away a tube buried in garden plot

indicators.note: buried in says the tube is placed inside the garden word

parts.note: a bed is a plot of ground in a garden for flowers
a duct is a tube or channel

explanation.surface: Someone dug a pipe out of a flower bed and carried it off.
explanation.definitionFit: Abducted means carried off by force, a kidnapping sense of removed.

clue.text: Deputy officer retreated with some hesitation

indicators.note: retreated says the officer abbreviation goes backwards, reading upwards in this down clue

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for colonel, an army officer
um is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A stand-in officer backed away while stammering.
explanation.definitionFit: A locum is a stand-in, especially a doctor or cleric covering for another.

clue.text: Section of platoon slaughtered in violent attack

indicators.note: Section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a platoon was massacred during a fierce assault.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce, violent assault, so 'in violent attack' is read as a description of one.

clue.text: Found out that daughter has insurance

parts.note: someone who has insurance is covered, so the phrase gives is covered

explanation.surface: Someone learned that their daughter holds an insurance policy.
explanation.definitionFit: Discovered means learned or detected, the sense of a secret coming to light.

clue.text: About to request a large container

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
to ask is to request

explanation.surface: Someone is about to ask for a big box.
explanation.definitionFit: A cask is a large barrel for holding liquids such as wine or beer.

clue.text: Wild predator shows little sign of distress

indicators.note: wild signals that the letters of the next word run free into a new order

explanation.surface: An untamed hunting animal displays a hint of suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: A tear falling from the eye is a small token of sorrow or upset.

clue.text: Struggle to fit doctor into jacket

indicators.note: into says the doctor fits inside the jacket word

parts.note: a coat is an outer jacket
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a medical degree and so a doctor

explanation.surface: Someone wrestles to squeeze a physician into a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: Combat is a fight or battle, a struggle between opponents.

clue.text: Talk with Tom in French

definitions.meaning: the French word for a cat, a tom being a male cat

explanation.definitionFit: The English word means informal conversation, and the identical French word names a cat, of which a tom is the male.

clue.text: Principal of frivolous nature used to dispel the gloom

parts.note: a head is the principal of a school
light-hearted or trivial matters are light

explanation.surface: A headteacher with a breezy manner cheers up a gloomy staffroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's lamp at the front pierces darkness, so it serves to drive away the dark.

clue.text: Others impound old register for religious study

indicators.note: impound says the other people hold the next pieces inside them

parts.note: they means other people
a log is a register or record

explanation.surface: Officials confiscate an ancient ledger used in a religious course.
explanation.definitionFit: Theology is the academic study of God and religious belief.

clue.text: Play pranks when there's a bird around

parts.note: a lark is a songbird
about means around

explanation.surface: Children fool about whenever a bird is nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: To fool around or horse about is to behave playfully and mischievously.

clue.text: Reasonable way to make an assessment

parts.note: a mode is a way or method
to rate something is to assess it

explanation.surface: Someone describes a sensible method of evaluating things.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderate means not extreme, within sensible limits.

clue.text: Writing like this is to me attractive

parts.note: a person's handwriting is their hand
so means in this way

explanation.surface: A person admires handwriting of a particular style.
explanation.definitionFit: Handsome means good-looking, pleasing in appearance.

clue.text: Utterly correct form of worship

indicators.note: utterly is read as when uttered, so the word for correct is spoken

parts.note: right means correct

explanation.surface: A proper and entirely appropriate religious ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: A rite is a ceremonial act or religious observance.

clue.text: Suit for use in the garden

definitions.meaning: one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards

explanation.definitionFit: One of the four card suits shares its name with the plural of the gardener's digging tool.

clue.text: Polite request for place to relax

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
to ease is to relax

explanation.surface: Someone politely asks for somewhere to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is said to make a request courteous.

clue.text: In war guerrillas may fail to agree

indicators.note: In says the answer sits inside the words that follow, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: During a conflict, irregular fighters may fall out with one another.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarrel or dispute is to fail to agree.

clue.text: Value a party leader gaining acclaim

indicators.note: leader asks for the first letter of the word party

parts.note: acclaim means praise

explanation.surface: A political leader is cheered and their worth assessed.
explanation.definitionFit: To appraise is to assess the worth of, to put a price on.

clue.text: Good man always has to be direct

parts.note: St, a saint, is a good man
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A virtuous man must always speak plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: To steer is to guide or direct the course of something.

clue.text: Excited to see a giant

parts.note: Gog is a legendary giant, with Magog, of British folklore

explanation.surface: Someone is thrilled to meet a giant.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means eagerly excited, full of expectation.

clue.text: Whence planes soared more freely

indicators.note: freely tells the solver the letters of the two words move about into a new order

explanation.surface: From these spots aircraft lifted off and climbed with ease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whence planes' means places from which aircraft come; the anagram of SOARED MORE fits the picture of flight.
explanation.definitionFit: Airfields are where aircraft take off and land, the places they depart from.

clue.text: Delicate English lady tucked into duck

indicators.note: tucked into says the lady goes inside the duck word

parts.note: a teal is a small duck
her stands for a lady

explanation.surface: A refined Englishwoman sits down to a meal of duck.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means light and airy, extremely delicate and refined.

clue.text: Such verse make Salvationists weary

parts.note: SA is the Salvation Army, whose members are Salvationists
to tire is to weary

explanation.surface: Poetry of this kind wears out the Salvation Army members.
explanation.definitionFit: Satire is writing, often in verse, that mocks folly through ridicule.
